protocol.mass: published: front + rear weight with a 68 kg driver (FSG car data)
protocol.cg_height: assumed: KinematiK default (VehicleParams.cg_height), never per car
protocol.tyre grip: assumed: KinematiK default_tire(), never per car
protocol.aero (ClA, CdA): assumed: KinematiK Powertrain defaults, never per car
protocol.power: rule: min(motors x published power per motor, FS accumulator power limit for the year)
protocol.drive: published: 4 motors = all-wheel drive, fewer = rear-wheel drive
protocol.overall ratio: published: the primary ratio; primary x secondary only when the primary is below 5; when front and rear ratios differ, the rear one
protocol.motor torque: assumed: enough for 2.0 g at the wheels (grip-limited launch)
protocol.acceleration: KinematiK laptime.acceleration_time over 75.0 m from rest
protocol.scoring exclusions: skidpad: left/right laps more than 10% apart, or any penalty in the best time; listed but left out of the summary

note: Results were public (2026-08-16) before this record was made. Protocol v1 was written before any prediction was compared with them, and not changed after.
